Examples:
An employee's mother dies on Sunday 1 November 2026: three days' leave to Tuesday 3 November, back at work on Wednesday 4 November.
A father starts parental leave on Monday 2 November with Saturday and Sunday off: it ends on Friday 6 November and he returns on Monday 9 November.

Frequently asked questions

How much bereavement leave is there in the UAE private sector?

5 paid days for the death of a spouse, and 3 paid days for the death of a parent, child, sibling, grandchild or grandparent, starting from the date of death, under Article 32 of Federal Decree-Law 33 of 2021.

How much paternity leave is there in the UAE?

Parental leave is 5 paid working days for the father or the mother to care for the newborn, taken in one block or separately within 6 months of the birth, on top of the mother's maternity leave.

Is there study leave in the UAE?

Yes: 10 working days a year to sit exams for employees studying at an accredited institution in the UAE, provided they have at least two years of service with the employer.

Does bereavement leave include weekends?

The text counts the leave in days starting from the date of death, so it runs as consecutive days. Parental and study leave are set in working days, so weekends are not counted.

Is there Hajj leave under the new UAE labour law?

Article 32 does not provide Hajj leave for the private sector, so it depends on the contract or company policy, or is taken from annual leave or as unpaid leave by agreement.
